text:
IncidentBot: [P1] High error rate for tenant Hera (enterprise VPC) in eu-west-1. 80% 5xx on inference endpoints. Impacting prod traffic. Auto-page oncall. Links: https://console.redwood/incident/INC-1749998888 :rotating_light:
Maria (oncall): acked. Pulling runbook now. tagging @Lee and @Sam.
Lee (sre): on it. checking pool health + dedicated hosts for Hera. Any recent deploys?
Sam (eng): no deploys from infra in last 6h. Looking at model runtime logs.
Devon (prodops): traffic graph shows sharp spike at 09:12 UTC. Error spikes correspond to node eviction events in eu-west-1a.
Maya (netops): seeing elevated retransmits on the VPC peering path to customer HERA-VPC. Could be network flapping.
Maria (oncall): paging Jordan (AE) and Helena (account) for customer comms. @Jordan can you reach out to their NOC?
Jordan (AE): calling customer NOC now. DMing phone.
Helena (account): I told them we're investigating and will provide timeline. They want a traffic-safe plan.
Sam (eng): tailing inference runtime logs: ```
[2026-03-15T09:12:03Z] kv-cache miss spikes
[2026-03-15T09:12:07Z] gRPC connection reset by peer
[2026-03-15T09:12:12Z] worker OOM then restart
```
Lee (sre): worker OOM + networking issues. Hypothesis: degraded host in the dedicated pool causing cascading connection resets. We should isolate Hera's tenant to a warm standby pool in another AZ/region.
Devon (prodops): we have warm capacity in eu-west-2 reserved for Hera (warm-reserve-hera). Ready to accept traffic if we DNS-shift.
Maria (oncall): plan: 1) Isolate tenant routing so only health checked hosts serve new traffic. 2) Gradually shift Hera's traffic to warm-reserve-hera in eu-west-2 via DNS with low TTL and canary. 3) Keep original pool in eu-west-1 drained but not terminated. 4) Continuous monitoring + rollback plan. Everyone agree? :thumbsup: / :thumbsdown:
Maya (netops): confirm DNS TTL for Hera entry is 60s now. Recommend lower to 30s before cutover.
Jordan (AE): customer NOC is on the line, they want a step-by-step and confirmation that keys/data stay in their VPC.
Helena (account): reassure them: control plane changes only; private data remains in their VPC. I'll stay on call with customer.
Lee (sre): I'm going to tag the dedicated pool and initiate tenant isolation. Command: ```
# isolate tenant Hera
redwoodctl pools drain --pool eu-west-1-dedicated-hera --tenant-id hera-ENT-42 --grace-period 120
```
Sam (eng): while draining, I'll prep the routing policy to accept traffic in eu-west-2. Config snippet: ```
routing_policy:
  - tenant: hera-ENT-42
    prefer_region: eu-west-2
    fallback: eu-west-1
    canary_percent: 5
    canary_duration: 300s
```
Devon (prodops): warm pool health check: returning OK across all nodes. Latency baseline + CPU within expected. Ready for canary.
Maria (oncall): executing DNS TTL change to 30s. Actioning now.
Maya (netops): changed DNS TTL for hera.prod.redwood -> 30s. Propagation should be fast.
IncidentBot: Change recorded: DNS TTL updated by Maria. Link: https://console.redwood/changes/CHG-88877
Jordan (AE): customer NOC acknowledged TTL change. They will monitor from their side.
Maria (oncall): starting a 5% canary to eu-west-2. Watch metrics for 10 minutes then increase.
Devon (prodops): canary started. 5% of Hera requests now routed to warm-reserve-hera.
Sam (eng): watching 5xx rate on canary: steady at 0.6%, baseline 0.5%. No spike.
Lee (sre): no OOMs on warm nodes. KV cache warmup looks slow but acceptable.
Maria (oncall): after 10m, canary looks healthy. Bumping to 25%.
Devon (prodops): 25% cutover in progress.
Sam (eng): metrics: Hera aggregate 5xx dropping from 80% to 12% as more traffic moves. Latency stable.
Jordan (AE): customer NOC reporting traffic is flowing to eu-west-2 and their errors dropping. They asked about certificate rotation — no changes to TLS certs required.
Helena (account): relaying to C-SAT team to standby for customer updates.
Lee (sre): continuing drain on eu-west-1 dedicated pool. Adding circuit breaker for host flaps: set host_retry_window=300s.
Maria (oncall): preparing full shift to eu-west-2 once at 90% and stable for 5m. Reminder: rollback plan is to revert DNS to eu-west-1 if 5xx > 5% for 2m.
Devon (prodops): at 80% shifted now. Watching for connection resets.
Sam (eng): small spike in cache misses during shift but within tolerances.
IncidentBot: Oncall handoff note: Maria assigned the incident to Lee for long-running mitigation at 09:36 UTC.
Lee (sre): taking lead. Maria, thanks. I'll keep the exec summary updated every 15m.
Helena (account): customer wants official timeline for RCA after stabilization. We'll request a joint postmortem.
Jordan (AE): customer says their internal retry logic smoothed the experience; they want to keep a shadow in eu-west-1 for warm fallback.
Lee (sre): agreed. we'll keep eu-west-1 drained but ready.
Maria (oncall): full shift to eu-west-2 now. Changing DNS weight to 100% via route control.
Maya (netops): DNS update pushed: all records now prefer eu-west-2 endpoints. TTL still 30s.
Devon (prodops): 100% shift completed; observed global request distribution now showing 99.6% to eu-west-2.
Sam (eng): 5xx now at 0.2% for Hera. Latency normal.
Jordan (AE): customer confirms service recovered on their side. They want periodic check-ins for the next 4 hours.
Lee (sre): I'll keep monitoring. Next steps: collect logs, preserve eu-west-1 hosts for forensic, and schedule swapback only after root cause analysis.
Maria (oncall): closing immediate paging. Assign follow-ups: RCA owner Sam, forensic host snapshot Lee, customer comms Helena/Jordan.
Helena (account): sending customer a recovery note and estimated RCA ETA 48h.
IncidentBot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: Hera tenant traffic shifted to warm pool in eu-west-2, error rates returned to baseline. Duration: ~24m. Postmortem required.
Maria (oncall): thanks everyone. If any artifacts (heap dumps, kernel logs) are captured, upload to the incident folder and tag Sam/Lee.
Sam (eng): will collect runtime dumps and upload.
Lee (sre): saving pool snapshots now. Command: ```
redwoodctl snapshot --pool eu-west-1-dedicated-hera --output s3://incidents/1749998888/pool-snapshot.tgz
```
Customer-NOC: thanks for the rapid response team. We'll validate on our end and report any anomalies.
Maria (oncall): end of thread for immediate mitigation. Continuing in #incidents-postmortem for RCA drafting. :white_check_mark:
